theorem.name: DegreeThreeSpectralTraceDecompositionTheorem
theorem.statement: For the smooth q79 degree-three spectral cover p:C->K3, p_*O_C splits canonically as O_K3 direct_sum phi_H^*Omega^1_P2. Consequently H^2(C,O_C) is the direct sum of a one-dimensional trace component and an eight-dimensional trace-free component.
